scenario.classification: declared hypothetical, not quote or forecast
scenario.unit: one loaded shipment from Dallas origin to accepted Houston receipt; one-year comparison; 250 loaded road miles assumed
scenario.costBoundary: Carrier price includes equipment, fuel, tolls, maintenance, normal roadside/remote support and repositioning. Common warehouse work included every option. Additional recovery expense above normal included support is modeled separately. No taxes, ordinary charges or minimum commitments differing between options assumed; obtain/reconcile these in actual quotes. No service credits/insurance recoveries counted.
qualifications: Demand and receiving capacity are assumed available.
Accepted shipments complete including modeled recoveries; incompatible/unsupported loads use human backup.
2% is assumed incremental exceptions relative to current arrangement, not an observed operator failure rate.
Lost contribution is separate from extra transport cost; no probability distribution or realized ROI asserted.
The comparison is first-year shipper cost; it does not estimate vehicle hours, fleet utilization, manufacturer unit economics or gross margin.
scenario.recheck: Replace assumptions with actual endpoint-approved quotes, requested/accepted/completed shipment records, invoices, extra staff time and measured exceptions after a bounded trial.
scenario.economicCostBoundary: Consistent comparison includes allocated existing warehouse/release labor, assumed paid carrier/recovery/setup costs and incremental lost contribution. It is not a cash invoice total. The 2% is incremental to conventional service, not an AV-only failure rate.

revisionReview.scope: Final exemption and cash/allocated-labor/lost-contribution boundaries reviewed; source-specific dates preserved.
